verdict.rationale: name.com has a dedicated doc explaining auto-renew, manual renew, and a 'Guaranteed Renewal Window' (grace/redemption behavior) plus webhooks for renewal/transfer/compliance events, and domain settings management explicitly includes autorenew toggling per domain. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of expiry email notice timing/cadence and independent/hands-on confirmation that renewal notices and redemption windows work as documented.
